The Cherry finish and Lyre Tail Vibrola™ on this handcrafted collectible are an amazing reproduction of the features of the original solid body instrument. data.descriptionHtml:
AXE HEAVEN® '64 SG Standard Cherry 1:4 Scale Mini Guitar Model

This AXE HEAVEN® 1:4 scale miniature replica model honors the '64 Gibson SG™ Standard. The Cherry finish and Lyre Tail Vibrola™ on this handcrafted collectible are an amazing reproduction of the features of the original solid body instrument.

  • Handcrafted from solid wood, with metal tuning keys

  • Measures approximately 10" L x 3" W x 0.5" D

  • Includes an AXE HEAVEN A-frame stand and guitar case gift box

data.title: Lifestyle Farewell Tour x Gibson Gold Logo Tee
data.description: This premium quality White Farewell Tour x Gibson Gold Logo Tee is made in collaboration with Farewell Tour® and features their patented guitar pick pocket. Farewell Tour® is an apparel brand created for guitar players. With patents issued in the USA and in Europe for guitar pick pocket garments, Farewell Tour® provides players easy accessibility to their guitar picks while playing. The brand’s mission is to create high quality products for everyday guitar players as well as touring artists. 100% cotton Unisex sizing Machine wash cold, hang dry

data.description: This premium quality White Farewell Tour x Gibson Clean Longsleeve Tee is made in collaboration with Farewell Tour® and features their patented guitar pick pocket. Farewell Tour® is an apparel brand created for guitar players. With patents issued in the USA and in Europe for guitar pick pocket garments, Farewell Tour® provides players easy accessibility to their guitar picks while playing. The brand’s mission is to create high quality products for everyday guitar players as well as touring artists. 100% cotton Unisex sizing Machine wash cold, hang dry

Whether you're onstage or out for a night at the local honky-tonk, you'll stay warm and look great in this jacket! Faux "pockets," zipper closure Gibson logo on the back 100% Polyester Wash cold. Tumble dry low.

data.title: Lifestyle Farewell Tour x Gibson Crewneck
data.description: This premium quality Black Farewell Tour x Gibson Crewneck is made in collaboration with Farewell Tour® and features their patented guitar pick pocket. Farewell Tour® is an apparel brand created for guitar players. With patents issued in the USA and in Europe for guitar pick pocket garments, Farewell Tour® provides players easy accessibility to their guitar picks while playing. The brand’s mission is to create high quality products for everyday guitar players as well as touring artists. 65% cotton, 35% polyester Unisex sizing Machine wash cold, hang dry
